newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks end week at all-time highs.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks end week at all-time highs.

text.p: CHANGE CHANGE

CANDLR 1.3543 LME CASH ALUM US$1322.5 -15.0
CAN 30-YR 106.80 +1.55 NOV BRENT CRUDE US$24.73 -0.08
* Toronto stocks hit all-time closing and intra-day highs
* TSE rides along with bond rally on favorable U.S. jobs data
* 10 of 14 sub-groups end higher * 99 million shares traded
Toronto stocks ended the week at all-time highs on Friday, buoyed by a North American bond rally on weaker-than-expected U.S. jobs data.
The TSE 300 Composite Index climbed 35.70 points to close at a record high of 5415.70. The key index also set a new intra-day peak of 5415.71.

Trading was brisk with volume of 99.5 million shares valued at C$1.48 billion. Advancing stocks raced ahead of declines 511 to 379 with 297 issues ending flat. "Things just keep moving along here in a remarkable fashion," said Fred Ketchen, director of equity trading for ScotiaMcLeod Inc.
Canadian bonds rallied along with U.S. treasuries after U.S. non-farm payrolls shrank by 40,000 jobs in September, compared to market expectations for moderate growth.
Canada's benchmark 9.00 percent bond closed up C$1.50 at C$106.75 to yield 7.414 percent.
In New York, the Dow Jones Industrial Average soared 60 points to end at 5992, just shy of the key 6000 level.
Ketchen said Canada's low interest rates continued to lure investors to rate-sensitive stocks such as banks, pipelines and utilities. Toronto ended today's session with gains in 10 of 14 sub-groups.
"We're due for a correction somewhere along the way, but until the economic fundamentals change there is nothing to cause it," Ketchen said.
--- HOT STOCKS ---
* BioChem Pharma Inc led net gainers, closing up 6.90 at 61 in light volume after the company said its new liver disease treatment may be more effective than anticipated.
* Bre-X Minerals Ltd. was the biggest loser, sinking 2.35 to 24.55 on 5.8 million shares amid uncertainty over the ownership of its multibillion-dollar Indonesian gold property.
* Toronto-Dominion Bank led bank issues, up 0.60 to 29.50.
